q: What is the carbon footprint of sewing thread per kg?
title: Sewing thread per kg
short: Most sewing thread is polyester or a poly-cotton core, so the fibre carries much of the footprint. Spinning or twisting, dyeing and winding onto cones add electricity and steam at the thread mill. Garment makers count bought thread as Scope 3.

p: Thread is a small share of a garment by weight. Fabric, dyeing and your own power usually matter far more.

senseible: Senseible reads the energy invoices behind the making stage into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, and keeps material invoices on the Scope 3 trail. Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
